episode_summary: Sarah Maslowski shares how YouTube can be a powerful tool for real estate lead generation, emphasizing the importance of creating content that resonates with potential clients. She provides actionable strategies for handling YouTube leads, including using intake forms and encouraging exploratory trips for relocation clients. The episode highlights the significance of consistent follow-up and building trust through content.
